response.overview: A psychological thriller that explores the fragile boundaries between reality, fear, and the human mind. When an unexpected incident disrupts a seemingly ordinary life, the protagonist is drawn into a disturbing chain of events where nothing is what it appears to be. As reality begins to blur, hidden truths slowly emerge, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and question his own perception of what is real.
